title: Encoded cell values
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with $k$ work tapes, a cell value consists of an optional head descriptor and, for each work tape, a pair comprising an optional Boolean symbol and a Boolean marker.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
